title: बंद कुएँ की आवाज़
script:
बीस साल से कुआँ पत्थर से बंद था। आज आवाज़ उसके ढक्कन के ऊपर से आई।
बहन, एक घूँट। इस बार यहीं रख देना।
रेखा मुड़ी। बारिश में सिर्फ़ उसके अपने पैरों के निशान थे।
उसने चूड़ियाँ पहचान लीं। ये सीता की थीं, जो सूखे के साल मर गई थी।
गाँव वालों ने तब सीता को पानी नहीं दिया था। कुएँ पर पहरा बैठा था।
रेखा ने लोटा रखा। पानी अपने आप पत्थर की दरार में खिंचने लगा।
ढक्कन पर रखो। नीचे वो अभी भी पहरा देता है।
रेखा ने लोटा सरकाकर बीच में कर दिया। पानी वहीं थम गया।
सीता ने पहला घूँट लिया। उसकी चूड़ियाँ पत्थर पर गिर गईं।
रेखा ने आँख झपकी। चौपाल खाली थी। लोटा फिर पूरा भरा था।
वह लोटा लेकर घर मुड़ी। पीछे पत्थर ज़रा भी नहीं हिला।
तभी लोटे के पानी से भारी आवाज़ उठी। अब पहरेदार को भी पिला दो।

scenes.first_frame_description: Rekha enters the edge of an empty courtyard holding a small round brass lota, an Indian water vessel, sealed lid fully visible.
scenes.visual_action: She stops and looks toward the top of the lid.

scenes.first_frame_description: Sita sits on the rim beside the lid, three-quarter face and both hands visible.
scenes.visual_action: Sita speaks once, points to the lid and lowers her hand.

scenes.first_frame_description: Rekha stands at lane mouth, a single trail of sandal prints leading to her.
scenes.visual_action: She scans the lane. Her hand tightens around the cup.

scenes.first_frame_description: Sita’s right wrist rests at her side, two copper bangles above the wet rim.
scenes.visual_action: One bangle slips toward her hand, then settles.
scenes.effects: Small bead of water rolls off bangle

scenes.first_frame_description: Rekha stands by the lane, Sita sits on the far edge of the sealed well.
scenes.visual_action: Rekha looks from Sita to the cup and takes one small step forward.

scenes.first_frame_description: Rekha’s hand holds a full brass cup a finger-width above the lid beside the rim seam.
scenes.visual_action: She sets it down. A thin water thread climbs over its lip and runs into the seam.
scenes.effects: One distinct thread of water, no moving lid

scenes.first_frame_description: Sita sits at the rim with her face and warning hand visible.
scenes.visual_action: She says the line once, glances at the seam and draws back her fingers.
scenes.effects: A drip falls past her wrist

scenes.first_frame_description: Brass cup by the rim, Rekha’s hand poised behind it, flat centre visible.
scenes.visual_action: She slides the cup toward the centre; the trickle breaks at once.

scenes.first_frame_description: Sita holds the cup just below her lips, bangles loose at her right wrist.
scenes.visual_action: She takes one sip. Her wrist drops and the bangles fall together.
scenes.sound_design: Small sip and two copper taps

scenes.first_frame_description: Rekha alone by the lid, the full brass cup and fallen bangles at its centre.
scenes.visual_action: Rekha blinks, then leans cautiously toward the cup.

scenes.first_frame_description: Rekha faces the lane carrying the full cup, edge of sealed well behind.
scenes.visual_action: She walks two steps into the lane. The lid stays in place.

scenes.first_frame_description: Close view of the cup in Rekha’s hand at waist height, surface flat.
scenes.visual_action: Ripples spread from the centre. Rekha’s hand freezes; cut on the widening rings.
scenes.effects: Three small concentric ripples from within cup
scenes.sound_design: Low water vibration; narrator performs the quoted words separately

title: खाली कमरे की चाबी
script:
मीना ने चाबी घुमाई। ताला बाहर था, लेकिन चाबी किसी ने अंदर से खींच ली।
कमरा खुला। भीतर सामान नहीं था। बस दीवार की कील पर वही चाबी टँगी थी।
बेटी, उसे मत उतारना। मैं भी यही भूल कर बैठा था।
मीना की उँगलियाँ चाबी पर थीं। उसने पलटकर देखा, और दरवाज़ा बंद हो गया।
अब वहाँ दरवाज़ा नहीं था। बस नीले रंग का चौकोर निशान था।
हरि कमरे के कोने में खड़ा था। उसकी हथेली में भी चाबी का निशान था।
जिसके हाथ में चाबी रहेगी, कमरा उसी को रख लेगा।
मीना ने हाथ खोला। चाबी गरम थी। उसके ऊपर कील अब भी खाली थी।
कमरे की चाबी, कमरे में।
नीले निशान में दरार खुली। हरि ने मीना को जाने दिया। वह खुद वहीं खड़ा रहा।
मीना सीढ़ियों तक पहुँची। पीछे दरवाज़ा बंद हुआ। उसने सोचा, बच गई।
फिर उसके बैग की जेब में पीतल खनका। कमरे ने चाबी फिर भेज दी थी।

scenes.first_frame_description: Meena’s fingers on a plain brass key seated in the outside lock.
scenes.visual_action: She turns once. The key slides inward and out of sight. Her fingers close on air.
scenes.effects: Chipped paint and lock stay fixed

scenes.first_frame_description: View from threshold, blue door ajar, Meena at edge and brass key on wall hook.
scenes.visual_action: She pushes the door open a little farther and follows the bare wall to the key.
scenes.camera: Small pan from empty floor to hook

scenes.first_frame_description: Hari in three-quarter profile under the hall lamp, looking toward the open doorway.
scenes.visual_action: He delivers the line once, visibly anxious, then closes his mouth.
scenes.effects: Soft rain behind the hall window

scenes.first_frame_description: Meena’s fingers hold the key against the hook, blue door still ajar.
scenes.visual_action: Her fingers lift the key as she looks back. The door swings fully shut.
scenes.camera: Medium close, key and door visible
scenes.effects: Door closes once; shadows remain consistent
scenes.sound_design: Small click followed by wood thud

scenes.first_frame_description: Meena faces a solid wall with a blue rectangular stain where the door stood.
scenes.visual_action: She runs her free hand across the wall and finds no gap.

scenes.first_frame_description: Hari in the far corner with palm open, Meena at left in profile, blue stain behind.
scenes.visual_action: Hari raises his open hand into the window light. Meena watches.
scenes.camera: Move from Meena’s eyeline to his palm
scenes.effects: Key-shaped old indent, no wound or gore

scenes.first_frame_description: Hari at right with mouth visible. Meena listens at left, holding the key down.
scenes.visual_action: Hari says the line once and looks toward her hand. Meena stays silent.
scenes.camera: Two-shot with Hari in near profile

scenes.first_frame_description: Open palm with key under the empty hook. Blue stain at the frame edge.
scenes.visual_action: She slowly raises the key by its ring toward the hook.

scenes.first_frame_description: Meena in profile beside the hook, key ring level with it.
scenes.visual_action: She says the line and sets the ring on the hook. Her fingertips withdraw.
scenes.camera: Static profile close-up showing mouth and hook
scenes.sound_design: Exact dialogue and soft brass tap

scenes.first_frame_description: Blue rectangle has begun to open by a finger-width. Hari stands back from it.
scenes.visual_action: Door swings inward; Meena crosses threshold. Hari watches with hands at his sides.
scenes.effects: Amber hall light spreads across floor

scenes.first_frame_description: Meena at the head of the stairs, breathing hard, blue door ajar behind.
scenes.visual_action: The door shuts. She touches the stair rail and exhales.

scenes.first_frame_description: Close on zipped outer pocket of Meena’s canvas bag, hand hovering above it.
scenes.visual_action: A key-shaped weight drops inside the fabric from nowhere. Meena pulls her hand back. Cut.
scenes.sound_design: One recognizable brass clink, then quiet
